_comment: Demographic model (DESIGN §4.1). Cohort model: population per settlement/unit is counts by sex × age band. All values are Omer-approved STARTING VALUES for tuning (2026-11-04) — deliberately faster than medieval reality. Yearly update runs in December (turn month index 11); hunger acts monthly.
_crowdingComment: DECIDED by Omer 2026-11-04 (value 1.0 is a draft for tuning): in the listed tiers, births are multiplied by (1 − penalty × idle share of hands). 0 = off. At 1.0 a village with 30 % of its hands idle has 30 % fewer births — land-starved villages stop growing instead of starving. Towns and cities are excluded: their idle hands are the workshop/recruit pool, not crowding.

hunger._comment: Extra deaths in a month with an empty granary = shortfall fraction × rate × population; vulnerable bands weighted double.

migration._comment: DESIGN §4.1: when a settlement forecasts that stock + monthly income − consumption will fall below triggerSafetyMonths of consumption before the next harvest arrives, and it has idle hands, this share of idle hands leaves each month, with dependants (proportional slice of all cohorts), for the parent settlement. Omer 2026-11-04: forecast trigger replaces the flat 3-month trigger.

trickle._comment: PROPOSED (Session 9, draft for Omer): the countryside feeds the town people as well as grain. Once a year (December) a settlement whose idle hands exceed minIdleShare of its hands sends sharePerYear of its idle hands, with dependants, to its parent — but only if the parent was fully fed that year (requireFedParent). spread randomizes the share by ±spread (0.5 → 50 %–150 % of sharePerYear). sharePerYear 0 turns it off.

noise._comment: PROPOSED (Session 9, draft for Omer). vitalSampling 1 = births and deaths are drawn as Poisson counts around the expected value (variance = mean, so villages jitter and cities barely move); 0 = exact fractions (the deterministic model). epidemic: each settlement each year has chancePerYear of an epidemic year in which deaths are multiplied by deathMultiplier; chance 0 turns it off. All draws come from the seeded game RNG, so a game still replays identically.

startingDistribution._comment: Shares used to create a settlement of N people; roughly stationary for the rates above. Men/women split 50/50 within each band.
